title: Playlist
description: Music playlist collection with creator, track count, followers, visibility settings, and creation date. Used for music streaming platforms, radio stations, and music curation services.

name.description: Name or title of the playlist

description.description: Description of the playlist's theme, mood, or purpose

creator.description: Full name of the user who created the playlist

tracks_count.description: Total number of tracks or songs in the playlist

followers.description: Number of users following or subscribed to this playlist

is_public.description: Whether the playlist is publicly visible and shareable, or private

created_at.description: Timestamp when the playlist was created
